newsitem.title: USA: Chips & Tech Q2 report disappoints Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Chips & Tech Q2 report disappoints Wall St.

text.p: Chips and Technologies Inc tumbled sharply after its earnings report for the second quarter ended December 31 failed to blow past Wall Street consensus earnings expectations as they have done previously.
Analysts said they were disappointed with Chips' second quarter earnings report of $0.42 per share, despite the fact that it beat the First Call analysts' consensus by a penny.
Chips and Technologies was the second most active Nasdaq issue, falling 4-5/8 to 17, a decline of more than 20 percent.
"It wasn't an overly optimistic report," said Hambrecht and Quist analyst Rob Chaplinsky.
